lines.beaver: 오늘 행사 어땠어? 표정이 좀 안 좋네.
lines.beaver_en: How was the event today? You don't look happy.
lines.beaver_roman: oneul haengsa eottaesseo? pyojeongi jom an jonne.
lines.en: Yeah, I really regret my outfit today.

lines.learner: 드레스가 좀 촌스러웠어. 다른 걸 입었어야 했는데.
lines.en: The dress was a bit tacky. I should have worn another one.
lines.roman: deureseuga jom chonseureowosseo. dareun geol ibeosseoya haenneunde.

lines.learner: 굽이 너무 높았어. 낮은 걸 신었어야 했는데.
lines.en: The heels were too high. I should have worn low ones.
lines.roman: gubi neomu nopasseo. najeun geol sineosseoya haenneunde.

lines.beaver: 가방은? 그 핸드백 새로 산 거지?
lines.beaver_en: What about your bag? That handbag is new, right?
lines.beaver_roman: gabangeun? geu haendeubaek saero san geoji?
lines.learner: 응, 가죽 핸드백인데 지퍼가 고장 났어.
lines.en: Yes, it's a leather handbag, but the zipper broke.
lines.roman: eung, gajuk haendeubaeginde jipeoga gojang nasseo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, you should have checked it first.
lines.en: Right. I should have taken it for repair yesterday.
Thanks. That necklace is my mom's.

lines.beaver_en: The belt suited you well too.
lines.en: The belt was so tight it was uncomfortable.

lines.beaver_en: Weren't you cold when you went outside?
lines.learner: 너무 추웠어. 외투를 입고 갔어야 했는데.
lines.en: It was freezing. I should have worn a coat.
lines.roman: neomu chuwosseo. oetureul ipgo gasseoya haenneunde.

lines.beaver_en: But why did you wear sunglasses indoors?
lines.en: I was so nervous, so I wore them. I should have taken them off.

lines.beaver_en: It's okay. Let's pick clothes together next time.
lines.learner: 좋아. 다음엔 패션에 더 신경 쓸게. 고마워!
lines.en: Okay. I'll pay more attention to fashion. Thanks!
lines.roman: joa. daeumen paesyeone deo singyeong sseulge. gomawo!
